The logic followed here is:

Logic: **The operations between consecutive numbers are: +2, ×2, ×2.**

For, 13 - 15 - 30 - 60

⇒ 13 + 2 = 15.

⇒ 15 × 2 = 30.

⇒ 30 × 2 = 60.

For, 3 - 5 - 10 - 20

⇒ 3 + 2 = 5.

⇒ 5 × 2 = 10.

⇒ 10 × 2 = 20.

**Option 1) 10 - 12 - 24 - 42**

⇒ 10 + 2 = 12. (Matches)

⇒ 12 × 2 = 24. (Matches)

⇒ 24 × 2 = 48 ≠ 42.

**Here, logic not followed.**

**Option 2) 8 - 10 - 20 - 40**

⇒ 8 + 2 = 10. (Matches)

⇒ 10 × 2 = 20. (Matches)

⇒ 20 × 2 = 40. (Matches)

**Here, logic followed.**

**Option 3) 15 - 17 - 34 - 44**

⇒ 15 + 2 = 17. (Matches)

⇒ 17 × 2 = 34. (Matches)

⇒ 34 × 2 = 68 ≠ 44.

**Here, logic not followed.**

**Option 4) 5 - 7 - 14 - 24**

⇒ 5 + 2 = 7. (Matches)

⇒ 7 × 2 = 14. (Matches)

⇒ 14 × 2 = 28 ≠ 24.

**Here, logic not followed.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down

the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as

adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3

and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(19, 354, 7)

(9, 73, 8)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **2nd number = (1st number)² - 3rd number.**

For, (19, 354, 7)

⇒ (19)² - 7

= 361 - 7 = 354.

For, (9, 73, 8)

⇒ (9)² - 8 

= 81 - 8 = 73.

**Option 1) (22, 481, 2)**

⇒ (22)² - 2 

= 484 - 2 

= 482 ≠ 481.

**Here, logic not followed.**

**Option 2) (28, 778, 5)**

⇒ (28)² - 5 

= 784 - 5

= 779 ≠ 778.

**Here, logic not followed.**

**Option 3) (39, 1510, 10)**

⇒ (39)² - 10 

= 1521 - 10

= 1511 ≠ 1510.

**Here, logic not followed.**

**Option 4) (3, -10, 19)**

⇒ (3)² - 19

= 9 - 19 = -10.

**Here, logic followed.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
